name: @dsh-chamber/dsh-runtime
description: Shared, host-agnostic dsh runtime version management core (design 18 §9.1): version trees / current pointer / override / snapshots / failures / activation journal, source-bound npm install via embedded pinned pnpm, the activation transaction and two-phase rollback/restore. Pure Node, no Electron/IPC; adapted by its two owners (desktop main / gateway server) through the StartupDeps/ApplyDeps/InstallerDeps DI seams — RuntimeHostAdapter remains a documented sketch.
